title: Find South African public service vacancies
summary: The government jobs page links to the Public Service Vacancy Circular for advertised government posts and provides guidance for job seekers, including CV and interview preparation. Vacancy availability changes; follow the official circular for current listings.

title: Job-search guidance
summary: The government information page provides job-hunting guidance and links to public-service vacancies, CV preparation, interview preparation, and employment information. Check the linked official sources for current requirements.
source_title: South African Government — Finding a job

title: Browse education services
summary: The government education-services index links to school and tertiary education processes, including matric-result services, school admission information, NSFAS assistance, and tertiary-application services. Open the official pages for current eligibility and dates.

title: NSFAS application guidance
summary: NSFAS explains how to create or access a myNSFAS profile, complete an application, provide supporting information, and track its status. Application windows and requirements can change; check the official page before acting. NSFAS states that applying is free.
source_title: National Student Financial Aid Scheme — How to apply
